name: Löwenzahn: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: An educational game based on the German TV show 'Löwenzahn'. The game teaches kids about nature, economy and technical aspects on the world.

name: Löwenzahn 2: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: The second installment of the educational game series based on the German TV show 'Löwenzahn'. The game teaches kids about nature, economy and technical aspects of the world.

name: Löwenzahn 3: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: Third installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include puppet theatre, magnets, clocks, knights, hares, forest & hedgehogs.

name: Löwenzahn 4: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: Fourth installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include Stone Age, evolution, sewer, bridges, digestion, the skeleton, space travel and cosmos.

name: Löwenzahn 5: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: Fifth installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include eye, nose, snails, mudflat and dike, inventions, railway and wheels, medicinal and poisonous herbs.

name: Löwenzahn 6: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: Sixth installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include bats, frogs, painting, electricity, autumn / winter, dam/river, hair, noodles.

name: Löwenzahn 7: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: Third installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include music and voice, writing and printing, factory and chocolate, bog, pigs, photography and dungarees.

name: Löwenzahn 8: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: The last installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include criminalistics, sailing, metals, telephone, dogs and wolves, mountains.
